CustomField.label: Actual Attendees
CustomField.description: Roll-Up Summary COUNT of Event_Registration__c child records where Registration_Status__c equals Attended. Represents confirmed post-event attendance. Only meaningful after the event has taken place and check-ins have been recorded.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The number of attendees who were checked in on the day. Populated after the event once registrations are updated to Attended status.
